notes.title: 10 000 Wishlists – Thank You!
notes.content: We're incredibly excited to share that our game has officially passed 10 000 wishlists on Steam!This means the world to our small team, and we’re beyond grateful for your support, interest, and excitement. Every wishlist helps us get one step closer to launch — and we can’t wait to show you more soon.Stay tuned, and thank you for being part of this journey!
